scope.experience: Conversational discussion of an uploaded document
scope.task: Upload a short PDF, request a summary, and ask questions about its arguments.
scope.configuration: Individual web chat with a supplied document; no code execution, connected apps or delegated agent tasks. No specific model or plan was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: An individual reading or writing with document context

conversational.rationale: Document uploads provide context for free-form prompts and follow-up questions rather than a mandatory form or fixed workflow.
conversational.uncertainty: Format and context limits can constrain what can actually be discussed.

specialization.rationale: The scoped workflow emphasizes documents, but Claude remains a general assistant rather than a dedicated professional-domain product.
specialization.uncertainty: A configured project, skill or domain workflow could be much more specialized.

autonomy.rationale: Claude can synthesize uploaded material into an answer, while users initiate each task and decide how to use or revise the output.
autonomy.uncertainty: File creation, code execution and tool-driven workflows are excluded.

accessibility.rationale: A familiar chat interface supports students and knowledge workers, but supplying and understanding documents adds a practical skills requirement.
accessibility.uncertainty: Plan quotas, supported formats and regional availability can limit participation; accessibility was not directly tested.

explainability.rationale: The original document is available for manual verification and users can ask for references, but document context alone does not guarantee quoted or correctly linked evidence for every answer.
explainability.uncertainty: The assessment does not assume all document answers have reliable citations or expose the model's internal reasoning.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: Claude document chat, excluding agents, connectors and code execution. Scores are design estimates. Sources: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8241126-upload-files-to-claude and https://support.claude.com/en/articles/7996845-what-are-some-things-i-can-use-claude-for .
